47	def discover_packs(root: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[PackDefinition, ...]:
48	    source_root = Path(root) if root is not None else packs_root()
49	    if not source_root.is_dir():
50	        return ()
51	    packs: list[PackDefinition] = []
52	    seen: dict[str, Path] = {}
53	    for child in sorted(source_root.iterdir(), key=lambda path: path.name):
54	        if not child.is_dir() or child.name.startswith(".") or child.name == "__pycache__":
55	            continue
56	        manifest_path = pack_manifest_path(child)
57	        if manifest_path is None:
58	            continue
59	        pack = load_pack_manifest(manifest_path)
60	        if pack.id in seen:
61	            raise PackValidationError(f"duplicate pack id {pack.id!r}: {seen[pack.id]} and {manifest_path}")
62	        seen[pack.id] = manifest_path
63	        packs.append(pack)
64	    return tuple(packs)

68	    manifest_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()

76	    metadata = data.get("metadata", {})

83	        root=root,

89	def pack_manifest_path(root: str | Path) -> Path | None:
90	    pack_root = Path(root)
91	    for name in PACK_MANIFEST_NAMES:
92	        candidate = pack_root / name
93	        if candidate.is_file():
94	            return candidate
95	    return None
96	
97	
98	def qualified_id_pack_id(value: str, *, path: str = "id") -> str:
99	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
100	        raise PackValidationError(f"{path} must be a non-empty qualified id")
101	    parts = value.split(".")
102	    if len(parts) < 2 or any(not part for part in parts):
103	        raise PackValidationError(f"{path} must be qualified as <pack>.<name>")
104	    _validate_pack_id(parts[0], f"{path} pack segment")
105	    return parts[0]
106	
107	
108	def validate_content_id_in_pack(content_id: str, pack: PackDefinition, *, content_type: str) -> None:
109	    owner = qualified_id_pack_id(content_id, path=f"{content_type}.id")
110	    if owner != pack.id:
111	        raise PackValidationError(
112	            f"{content_type} id {content_id!r} belongs to pack {owner!r} but was found in pack {pack.id!r}"
113	        )
114	
115	
116	def validate_element_pack_id(pack_id: str | None, pack: PackDefinition, *, element_root: str | Path) -> None:
117	    if not pack_id:
118	        raise PackValidationError(f"element {Path(element_root)} is missing metadata.pack_id")
119	    if pack_id != pack.id:
120	        raise PackValidationError(
121	            f"element {Path(element_root)} declares pack_id {pack_id!r} but was found in pack {pack.id!r}"
122	        )
123	
124	
125	def iter_executor_roots(pack: PackDefinition) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
126	    return _content_roots(pack.root, EXECUTOR_MANIFEST_NAMES, excluded_parts={"elements"})
127	
128	
129	def iter_orchestrator_roots(pack: PackDefinition) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
130	    return _content_roots(pack.root, ORCHESTRATOR_MANIFEST_NAMES, excluded_parts={"elements"})
131	
132	
133	def iter_element_roots(pack: PackDefinition, *, kind: str | None = None) -> tuple[tuple[ElementKind, Path], ...]:
134	    kinds: Iterable[str] = ELEMENT_KINDS if kind is None else (kind,)
135	    roots: list[tuple[ElementKind, Path]] = []
136	    for element_kind in kinds:
137	        if element_kind not in ELEMENT_KINDS:
138	            raise PackValidationError(f"element kind must be one of {list(ELEMENT_KINDS)}")
139	        kind_root = pack.root / "elements" / element_kind
140	        if not kind_root.is_dir():
141	            continue
142	        roots.extend((element_kind, child) for child in sorted(kind_root.iterdir()) if child.is_dir())
143	    return tuple(roots)
144	
145	
146	def _content_roots(root: Path, manifest_names: tuple[str, ...], *, excluded_parts: set[str]) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
147	    roots = {
148	        path.parent.resolve()
149	        for manifest_name in manifest_names
150	        for path in root.rglob(manifest_name)
151	        if "__pycache__" not in path.parts and excluded_parts.isdisjoint(path.relative_to(root).parts)
152	    }
153	    return tuple(sorted(roots))
154	
155	
156	def _load_manifest_payload(path: Path) -> Any:
157	    try:
158	        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
159	    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
160	        raise PackValidationError(f"pack manifest not found: {path}") from exc
161	    if path.suffix.lower() == ".json":
162	        try:
163	            return json.loads(text)
164	        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
165	            raise PackValidationError(f"invalid JSON pack manifest {path}: {exc.msg}") from exc
166	    return _parse_flat_yaml(text, path=path)
167	
168	
169	def _parse_flat_yaml(text: str, *, path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
170	    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
171	    for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
172	        stripped = raw_line.strip()
173	        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
174	            continue
175	        if raw_line[: len(raw_line) - len(raw_line.lstrip())].strip():
176	            raise PackValidationError(f"{path}: invalid indentation at line {line_number}")
177	        if ":" not in stripped:
178	            raise PackValidationError(f"{path}: expected key: value at line {line_number}")
179	        key, value = stripped.split(":", 1)
180	        key = key.strip()
181	        value = _strip_comment(value.strip())
182	        if not key:
183	            raise PackValidationError(f"{path}: empty key at line {line_number}")
184	        if value in {"", "{}"}:
185	            data[key] = {}
186	        else:
187	            data[key] = _unquote(value)
188	    if not data:
189	        raise PackValidationError(f"{path}: empty pack manifest")
190	    return data
191	
192	
193	def _strip_comment(value: str) -> str:
194	    in_quote: str | None = None
195	    for index, char in enumerate(value):
196	        if char in {"'", '"'} and (index == 0 or value[index - 1] != "\\"):
197	            in_quote = None if in_quote == char else char if in_quote is None else in_quote
198	        if char == "#" and in_quote is None and (index == 0 or value[index - 1].isspace()):
199	            return value[:index].rstrip()
200	    return value
201	
202	
203	def _unquote(value: str) -> str:
204	    if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in {"'", '"'}:
205	        return value[1:-1]
206	    return value
207	
208	
209	def _require_mapping(raw: Any, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
210	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
211	        raise PackValidationError(f"{path} must be an object")
212	    return raw
213	
214	
215	def _require_string(data: dict[str, Any], key: str, path: str) -> str:
216	    if key not in data:
217	        raise PackValidationError(f"missing required field {path}")
218	    value = data[key]
219	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
220	        raise PackValidationError(f"{path} must be a non-empty string")
221	    return value
222	
223	
224	def _optional_string(data: dict[str, Any], key: str, path: str, *, default: str) -> str:
225	    if key not in data or data[key] == "":
226	        return default
227	    value = data[key]
228	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
229	        raise PackValidationError(f"{path} must be a non-empty string")
230	    return value
231	
232	
233	def _validate_pack_id(value: str, path: str) -> None:
234	    if not _PACK_ID_RE.match(value) or value in {".", ".."}:
235	        raise PackValidationError(f"{path} must be a safe pack identifier")
236	
237

40	class ExecutorRegistryError(ExecutorValidationError):
41	    """Raised when a executor registry is inconsistent."""

44	class ExecutorRegistry:
45	    """Small in-memory registry keyed by executor id."""
46	
47	    def __init__(self, executors: Iterable[ExecutorDefinition | dict[str, Any]] = ()) -> None:
48	        self._executors: dict[str, ExecutorDefinition] = {}
49	        for executor in executors:
50	            self.register(executor)
51	
52	    def register(self, executor: ExecutorDefinition | dict[str, Any]) -> ExecutorDefinition:
53	        definition = validate_executor_definition(executor)
54	        if definition.id in self._executors:
55	            raise ExecutorRegistryError(f"duplicate executor id {definition.id!r}")
56	        self._executors[definition.id] = definition
57	        return definition
58	
59	    def get(self, executor_id: str) -> ExecutorDefinition:
60	        try:
61	            return self._executors[executor_id]
62	        except KeyError as exc:
63	            raise KeyError(f"unknown executor id {executor_id!r}") from exc
64	
65	    def list(self, kind: str | None = None) -> tuple[ExecutorDefinition, ...]:
66	        if kind is not None and kind not in {"built_in", "external"}:
67	            raise ExecutorRegistryError("kind must be one of ['built_in', 'external']")
68	        executors = self._executors.values()
69	        if kind is not None:
70	            executors = [executor for executor in executors if executor.kind == kind]
71	        return tuple(sorted(executors, key=lambda executor: executor.id))
72	
73	    def validate_all(self) -> tuple[ExecutorDefinition, ...]:
74	        for executor in self._executors.values():
75	            validate_executor_definition(executor)
76	        self._validate_graph_references()
77	        return self.list()
78	
79	    def to_dict(self, kind: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
80	        return {"executors": [executor.to_dict() for executor in self.list(kind=kind)]}
81	
82	    def to_json(self, *, kind: str | None = None, indent: int | None = 2) -> str:
83	        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(kind=kind), indent=indent, sort_keys=True)

85	    def as_mapping(self) -> MappingProxyType[str, ExecutorDefinition]:
86	        return MappingProxyType(dict(self._executors))

88	    def _validate_graph_references(self) -> None:
89	        known_ids = set(self._executors)

91	            for dependency in executor.graph.depends_on:
92	                if dependency not in known_ids:
93	                    raise ExecutorRegistryError(f"executor {executor.id!r} depends on unknown executor {dependency!r}")
94	                if dependency == executor.id:
95	                    raise ExecutorRegistryError(f"executor {executor.id!r} cannot depend on itself")

210	def _package_manifest_paths(package: str, source_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
211	    paths: list[Path] = []
212	    try:
213	        package_root = resources.files(package)
214	        paths.extend(Path(str(item)) for item in package_root.iterdir() if item.name.endswith(".json"))
215	    except (FileNotFoundError, ModuleNotFoundError, TypeError):
216	        pass
217	
218	    if paths:
219	        return tuple(sorted(paths))
220	
221	    if not source_root.is_dir():
222	        return ()
223	    return tuple(sorted(source_root.glob("*.json")))

227	    paths: list[Path] = []

231	    except (FileNotFoundError, ModuleNotFoundError, TypeError):
232	        pass
233	
234	    if paths:

236	
237	    if not source_root.is_dir():
238	        return ()
239	    return tuple(sorted(path for path in source_root.iterdir() if path.is_dir()))

1	from __future__ import annotations
2	
3	from pathlib import Path
4	
5	PACKAGE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
6	REPO_ROOT = PACKAGE_ROOT.parent
7	WORKSPACE_ROOT = REPO_ROOT.parent
8	
9	# Map of bin-style script filenames (e.g. "render_remotion.py") to the
10	# canonical executor module that owns the behavior. Keeps callers free to use
11	# the legacy filename while we migrate, and makes the one name mismatch
12	# (render_remotion -> executors.render) explicit in one place.
13	_EXECUTOR_MODULE_OVERRIDES = {
14	    "render_remotion": "artagents.executors.render.run",
15	}
16	
17	
18	def executor_argv(script_name: str, python_exec: str) -> list[str]:
19	    """Return argv tokens that invoke an executor's canonical module entrypoint.
20	
21	    `script_name` accepts either a bare step name (``"transcribe"``) or the
22	    legacy ``bin/`` filename (``"transcribe.py"``).
23	    """
24	    stem = script_name[:-3] if script_name.endswith(".py") else script_name
25	    module = _EXECUTOR_MODULE_OVERRIDES.get(stem, f"artagents.executors.{stem}.run")
26	    return [python_exec, "-m", module]
27

40	class ExecutorRegistryError(ExecutorValidationError):
41	    """Raised when a executor registry is inconsistent."""
42

44	class ExecutorRegistry:
45	    """Small in-memory registry keyed by executor id."""
46	
47	    def __init__(self, executors: Iterable[ExecutorDefinition | dict[str, Any]] = ()) -> None:
48	        self._executors: dict[str, ExecutorDefinition] = {}
49	        for executor in executors:
50	            self.register(executor)
51	
52	    def register(self, executor: ExecutorDefinition | dict[str, Any]) -> ExecutorDefinition:
53	        definition = validate_executor_definition(executor)
54	        if definition.id in self._executors:
55	            raise ExecutorRegistryError(f"duplicate executor id {definition.id!r}")
56	        self._executors[definition.id] = definition
57	        return definition
58	
59	    def get(self, executor_id: str) -> ExecutorDefinition:
60	        try:
61	            return self._executors[executor_id]
62	        except KeyError as exc:
63	            raise KeyError(f"unknown executor id {executor_id!r}") from exc
64	
65	    def list(self, kind: str | None = None) -> tuple[ExecutorDefinition, ...]:
66	        if kind is not None and kind not in {"built_in", "external"}:
67	            raise ExecutorRegistryError("kind must be one of ['built_in', 'external']")
68	        executors = self._executors.values()
69	        if kind is not None:
70	            executors = [executor for executor in executors if executor.kind == kind]
71	        return tuple(sorted(executors, key=lambda executor: executor.id))
72	
73	    def validate_all(self) -> tuple[ExecutorDefinition, ...]:
74	        for executor in self._executors.values():
75	            validate_executor_definition(executor)
76	        self._validate_graph_references()
77	        return self.list()
78	
79	    def to_dict(self, kind: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
80	        return {"executors": [executor.to_dict() for executor in self.list(kind=kind)]}
81	
82	    def to_json(self, *, kind: str | None = None, indent: int | None = 2) -> str:
83	        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(kind=kind), indent=indent, sort_keys=True)
84	
85	    def as_mapping(self) -> MappingProxyType[str, ExecutorDefinition]:
86	        return MappingProxyType(dict(self._executors))

88	    def _validate_graph_references(self) -> None:
89	        known_ids = set(self._executors)
90	        for executor in self._executors.values():
91	            for dependency in executor.graph.depends_on:
92	                if dependency not in known_ids:
93	                    raise ExecutorRegistryError(f"executor {executor.id!r} depends on unknown executor {dependency!r}")
94	                if dependency == executor.id:
95	                    raise ExecutorRegistryError(f"executor {executor.id!r} cannot depend on itself")

99	    folder_executors: list[ExecutorDefinition] = []
100	    expected_ids = {f"builtin.{step_name}" for step_name in BUILTIN_STEP_ORDER}
101	    for path in _builtin_folder_roots():
102	        folder_executors.extend(load_folder_executors(path))
103	    by_id = {executor.id: executor for executor in folder_executors if executor.id in expected_ids}
104	    missing = [f"builtin.{step_name}" for step_name in BUILTIN_STEP_ORDER if f"builtin.{step_name}" not in by_id]
105	    if missing:
106	        raise ExecutorRegistryError(f"missing built-in executor folder metadata: {', '.join(missing)}")
107	    return tuple(by_id[f"builtin.{step_name}"] for step_name in BUILTIN_STEP_ORDER)

156	    executors: list[ExecutorDefinition] = []

159	            for executor in load_folder_executors(root):
160	                validate_content_id_in_pack(executor.id, pack, content_type="executor")
161	                executors.append(_attach_pack_metadata(executor, pack.id))
162	    return tuple(executors)

168	    return validate_executor_definition(replace(executor, metadata=metadata))

192	def _project_folder_roots() -> tuple[Path, ...]:
193	    source_root = _content_root()

202	        )

210	def _package_manifest_paths(package: str, source_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
211	    paths: list[Path] = []
212	    try:
213	        package_root = resources.files(package)
214	        paths.extend(Path(str(item)) for item in package_root.iterdir() if item.name.endswith(".json"))
215	    except (FileNotFoundError, ModuleNotFoundError, TypeError):
216	        pass
217	
218	    if paths:
219	        return tuple(sorted(paths))
220	
221	    if not source_root.is_dir():
222	        return ()
223	    return tuple(sorted(source_root.glob("*.json")))
224	
225	
226	def _package_folder_roots(package: str, source_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
227	    paths: list[Path] = []
228	    try:
229	        package_root = resources.files(package)
230	        paths.extend(Path(str(item)) for item in package_root.iterdir() if item.is_dir())
231	    except (FileNotFoundError, ModuleNotFoundError, TypeError):
232	        pass
233	
234	    if paths:
235	        return tuple(sorted(paths))
236	
237	    if not source_root.is_dir():
238	        return ()
239	    return tuple(sorted(path for path in source_root.iterdir() if path.is_dir()))

149	def _public_child_dirs(root: Path, skipped: set[str]) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
150	    return tuple(sorted(path for path in root.iterdir() if path.is_dir() and path.name not in skipped and not path.name.startswith(".")))

153	def _require_files(folder: Path, filenames: tuple[str, ...], *, root: Path) -> list[str]:
154	    return [f"{folder.relative_to(root)} missing {filename}" for filename in filenames if not (folder / filename).is_file()]

145	    for path in _curated_manifest_paths():
146	        definition = load_orchestrator_manifest(path)
147	        if not _is_builtin_definition(definition):
148	            orchestrators.append(definition)
149	    for path in _curated_folder_roots():
150	        orchestrators.extend(definition for definition in load_folder_orchestrators(path) if not _is_builtin_definition(definition))
151	    return tuple(orchestrators)
152	
153	
154	def load_bundled_orchestrators() -> tuple[OrchestratorDefinition, ...]:
155	    orchestrators: list[OrchestratorDefinition] = []
156	    for path in _bundled_manifest_paths():
157	        definition = load_orchestrator_manifest(path)
158	        if not _is_builtin_definition(definition):
159	            orchestrators.append(definition)
160	    for path in _bundled_folder_roots():
161	        orchestrators.extend(definition for definition in load_folder_orchestrators(path) if not _is_builtin_definition(definition))
162	    return tuple(orchestrators)
163	
164	
165	def load_default_registry(
166	    *,
167	    executor_registry: ExecutorRegistry | None = None,
168	    banodoco_config: Any | None = None,
169	) -> OrchestratorRegistry:
170	    active_executor_registry = executor_registry
171	    registry = OrchestratorRegistry(executor_registry=active_executor_registry)
172	    for orchestrator in load_pack_orchestrators():
173	        registry.register(orchestrator)
174	    for orchestrator in load_builtin_orchestrators():
175	        registry.register(orchestrator)
176	    for orchestrator in load_bundled_orchestrators():
177	        registry.register(orchestrator)
178	    for orchestrator in load_curated_orchestrators():
179	        registry.register(orchestrator)
180	    registry.validate_all(executor_registry=active_executor_registry)
181	    return registry
182	
183	
184	def load_pack_orchestrators() -> tuple[OrchestratorDefinition, ...]:
185	    orchestrators: list[OrchestratorDefinition] = []
186	    for pack in discover_packs():
187	        for root in iter_orchestrator_roots(pack):
188	            for orchestrator in load_folder_orchestrators(root):
189	                validate_content_id_in_pack(orchestrator.id, pack, content_type="orchestrator")
190	                orchestrators.append(_attach_pack_metadata(orchestrator, pack.id))
191	    return tuple(orchestrators)
192	
193	
194	def _attach_pack_metadata(orchestrator: OrchestratorDefinition, pack_id: str) -> OrchestratorDefinition:
195	    metadata = dict(orchestrator.metadata)
196	    metadata.update({"pack_id": pack_id, "source": "pack"})
197	    return validate_orchestrator_definition(replace(orchestrator, metadata=metadata))
198	
199	
200	def _curated_manifest_paths() -> tuple[Path, ...]:
201	    return _package_manifest_paths(CURATED_PACKAGE, _content_root() / "curated")
202	
203	
204	def _curated_folder_roots() -> tuple[Path, ...]:
205	    return _package_folder_roots(CURATED_PACKAGE, _content_root() / "curated")
206	
207	
208	def _bundled_manifest_paths() -> tuple[Path, ...]:
209	    return _package_manifest_paths(BUNDLED_PACKAGE, _content_root() / "bundled")
210	
211	
212	def _bundled_folder_roots() -> tuple[Path, ...]:
213	    return _package_folder_roots(BUNDLED_PACKAGE, _content_root() / "bundled")
214	
215	
216	def _builtin_folder_roots() -> tuple[Path, ...]:
217	    root = _content_root()
218	    skip = {"__pycache__", "bundled", "curated"}
219	    return tuple(
220	        path
221	        for path in sorted(root.iterdir())
222	        if path.is_dir()
223	        and path.name not in skip
224	        and (path / "orchestrator.yaml").is_file()
225	        and (path / "run.py").is_file()
226	    )
227	
228	
229	def _content_root() -> Path:
230	    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "orchestrators"
231	
232	
233	def _package_manifest_paths(package: str, source_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
234	    paths: list[Path] = []
235	    try:
236	        package_root = resources.files(package)
237	        paths.extend(Path(str(item)) for item in package_root.iterdir() if item.name.endswith(".json"))
238	    except (FileNotFoundError, ModuleNotFoundError, TypeError):
239	        pass
240	
241	    if paths:
242	        return tuple(sorted(paths))
243	
244	    if not source_root.is_dir():
245	        return ()
246	    return tuple(sorted(source_root.glob("*.json")))
247	
248	
249	def _package_folder_roots(package: str, source_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
250	    paths: list[Path] = []
251	    try:
252	        package_root = resources.files(package)
253	        paths.extend(Path(str(item)) for item in package_root.iterdir() if item.is_dir())
254	    except (FileNotFoundError, ModuleNotFoundError, TypeError):
255	        pass
256	
257	    if paths:
258	        return tuple(sorted(paths))
259	
260	    if not source_root.is_dir():
261	        return ()
262	    return tuple(sorted(path for path in source_root.iterdir() if path.is_dir()))
263	
264	
265	def _is_builtin_definition(orchestrator: OrchestratorDefinition) -> bool:
266	    return orchestrator.kind == "built_in" or orchestrator.id.startswith("builtin.")
267	
268	
269	__all__ = [
270	    "OrchestratorRegistry",
271	    "OrchestratorRegistryError",
272	    "load_builtin_orchestrators",
273	    "load_bundled_orchestrators",
274	    "load_curated_orchestrators",
275	    "load_pack_orchestrators",
276	    "load_default_registry",
277	]

validate_orchestrator_definition,\n)\nfrom .folder import load_folder_orchestrators\n\n\nclass OrchestratorRegistryError(OrchestratorValidationError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an orchestrator registry Iterable[OrchestratorDefinition | dict[str, Any]] = (),\n        *,\n        executor_registry: ExecutorRegistry | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._orchestrators: dict[str, orchestrator: OrchestratorDefinition | dict[str, Any]) -> OrchestratorDefinition:\n        definition = validate_orchestrator_definition(orchestrator)\n        if definition.id in self._orchestrators:\n            raise OrchestratorRegistryError(f\"duplicate orchestrator id {definition.id!r}\")\n        self._orchestrators[definition.id] = definition\n        return definition\n\n    def get(self, orchestrator_id: str) -> OrchestratorDefinition:\n        try:\n            return self._orchestrators[orchestrator_id]\n        except KeyError as exc:\n            raise KeyError(f\"unknown orchestrator id {orchestrator_id!r}\") from exc\n\n    def list(self, kind: str | None = None) -> tuple[OrchestratorDefinition, ...]:\n        if kind is not None and kind not in {\"built_in\", \"external\"}:\n            raise OrchestratorRegistryError(\"kind must be one of ['built_in', 'external']\")\n        orchestrators: Iterable[OrchestratorDefinition] = self._orchestrators.values()\n        if kind is not None:\n            orchestrators = [orchestrator for orchestrator in orchestrators if orchestrator.kind == kind]\n        return tuple(sorted(orchestrators, key=lambda orchestrator: orchestrator.id))\n\n    def validate_all(\n        self,\n        *,\n        executor_registry: ExecutorRegistry | None = None,\n    ) -> tuple[OrchestratorDefinition, ...]:\n        for orchestrator in self._orchestrators.values():\n            validate_orchestrator_definition(orchestrator)\n        self._validate_child_executors(executor_registry=executor_registry)\n        self._validate_child_orchestrators()\n        return self.list()\n\n    def to_dict(self, kind: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\"orchestrators\": [orchestrator.to_dict() for orchestrator in self.list(kind=kind)]}\n\n    def to_json(self, *, kind: str | None = None, indent: int | None = 2) -> str:\n        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(kind=kind), indent=indent, sort_keys=True)\n\n    def as_mapping(self) -> MappingProxyType[str, OrchestratorDefinition]:\n        return MappingProxyType(dict(self._orchestrators))\n\n    def _validate_child_executors(self, *, executor_registry: ExecutorRegistry | None) -> None:\n        registry = executor_registry or self._executor_registry or load_default_executor_registry()\n        known_executor_ids = set(registry.as_mapping())\n        for orchestrator in self._orchestrators.values():\n            for child_executor in orchestrator.child_executors:\n                if child_executor not in known_executor_ids:\n                    raise OrchestratorRegistryError(\n                        f\"orchestrator {orchestrator.id!r} references unknown child executor {child_executor!r}\"\n                    )\n\n    def _validate_child_orchestrators(self) -> None:\n        known_orchestrator_ids = set(self._orchestrators)\n        graph: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {}\n        for orchestrator in self._orchestrators.values():\n            children: list[str] = []\n            for child_orchestrator in orchestrator.child_orchestrators:\n                if child_orchestrator not in known_orchestrator_ids:\n                    raise OrchestratorRegistryError(\n                        f\"orchestrator {orchestrator.id!r} references unknown child orchestrator {child_orchestrator!r}\"\n                    )\n                if child_orchestrator == orchestrator.id:\n                    raise OrchestratorRegistryError(f\"orchestrator {orchestrator.id!r} cannot reference itself\")\n                children.append(child_orchestrator)\n            graph[orchestrator.id] = tuple(children)\n        self._validate_no_cycles(graph)\n\n    def _validate_no_cycles(self, graph: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]) -> None:\n        visiting: set[str] = set()\n        visited: set[str] = set()\n        stack: list[str] = []\n\n        def visit(orchestrator_id: str) -> None:\n            if orchestrator_id in visited:\n                return\n            if orchestrator_id in visiting:\n                cycle = stack[stack.index(orchestrator_id) :] + [orchestrator_id]\n                raise OrchestratorRegistryError(f\"orchestrator cycle detected: {' -> '.join(cycle)}\")\n            visiting.add(orchestrator_id)\n            stack.append(orchestrator_id)\n            for child in graph.get(orchestrator_id, ()):\n                visit(child)\n            stack.pop()\n            visiting.remove(orchestrator_id)\n            visited.add(orchestrator_id)\n\n        for orchestrator_id in sorted(graph):\n            visit(orchestrator_id)\n\n\ndef load_default_registry(\n    *,\n    executor_registry: ExecutorRegistry | None = None,\n    banodoco_config: Any | None = None,\n) -> OrchestratorRegistry:\n    active_executor_registry = executor_registry\n    registry = OrchestratorRegistry(executor_registry=active_executor_registry)\n    for orchestrator in load_pack_orchestrators():\n        registry.register(orchestrator)\n    registry.validate_all(executor_registry=active_executor_registry)\n    return registry\n\n\ndef load_pack_orchestrators() -> tuple[OrchestratorDefinition, ...]:\n    orchestrators: list[OrchestratorDefinition] = []\n    for pack in discover_packs():\n        for root in iter_orchestrator_roots(pack):\n            for orchestrator in load_folder_orchestrators(root):\n                validate_content_id_in_pack(orchestrator.id, pack, content_type=\"orchestrator\")\n                orchestrators.append(_attach_pack_metadata(orchestrator, pack.id))\n    return tuple(orchestrators)\n\n\ndef _attach_pack_metadata(orchestrator: OrchestratorDefinition, pack_id: str) -> OrchestratorDefinition:\n    metadata = dict(orchestrator.metadata)\n    metadata.setdefault(\"pack_id\", pack_id)\n    metadata[\"source\"] = \"pack\"\n    return validate_orchestrator_definition(replace(orchestrator, metadata=metadata))\n\n\n__all__ = [\n 2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import os
6	import shutil
7	import sys
8	from dataclasses import dataclass
9	from importlib import resources
10	from pathlib import Path
11	from types import MappingProxyType
12	from typing import Iterable
13	
14	from artagents._paths import REPO_ROOT
15	from artagents.core.pack import discover_packs, iter_element_roots, validate_element_pack_id
16	
17	from .schema import ELEMENT_KINDS, ElementDefinition, ElementKind, ElementValidationError, load_element_definition
18	
19	
20	class ElementRegistryError(ElementValidationError):
21	    """Raised when element registry state is inconsistent."""
22	
23	
24	@dataclass(frozen=True)
25	class ElementSource:
26	    name: str
27	    root: Path
28	    priority: int
29	    editable: bool
30	
31	
32	@dataclass(frozen=True)
33	class ElementConflict:
34	    kind: ElementKind
35	    id: str
36	    winner: ElementDefinition
37	    shadowed: tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]
38	
39	
40	class ElementRegistry:
41	    """Resolved element registry keyed by kind and element id."""
42	
43	    def __init__(self, elements: Iterable[ElementDefinition] = ()) -> None:
44	        self._all: dict[tuple[str, str], list[ElementDefinition]] = {}
45	        for element in elements:
46	            self.register(element)
47	
48	    def register(self, element: ElementDefinition) -> ElementDefinition:
49	        key = (element.kind, element.id)
50	        self._all.setdefault(key, []).append(element)
51	        self._all[key].sort(key=lambda item: (item.priority, item.source, str(item.root)))
52	        return element
53	
54	    def get(self, kind: str, element_id: str) -> ElementDefinition:
55	        key = (kind, element_id)
56	        try:
57	            return self._all[key][0]
58	        except KeyError as exc:
59	            raise KeyError(f"unknown {kind} element {element_id!r}") from exc
60	
61	    def list(self, kind: str | None = None) -> tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]:
62	        if kind is not None and kind not in ELEMENT_KINDS:
63	            raise ElementRegistryError(f"kind must be one of {list(ELEMENT_KINDS)}")
64	        winners = [definitions[0] for (item_kind, _), definitions in self._all.items() if kind is None or item_kind == kind]
65	        return tuple(sorted(winners, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.id)))
66	
67	    def conflicts(self) -> tuple[ElementConflict, ...]:
68	        conflicts: list[ElementConflict] = []
69	        for (kind, element_id), definitions in self._all.items():
70	            if len(definitions) > 1:
71	                conflicts.append(
72	                    ElementConflict(
73	                        kind=kind,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
74	                        id=element_id,
75	                        winner=definitions[0],
76	                        shadowed=tuple(definitions[1:]),
77	                    )
78	                )
79	        return tuple(sorted(conflicts, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.id)))
80	
81	    def as_mapping(self) -> MappingProxyType[tuple[str, str], ElementDefinition]:
82	        return MappingProxyType({key: definitions[0] for key, definitions in self._all.items()})
83	
84	    def fork_target(self, kind: str, element_id: str, *, project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT) -> Path:
85	        element = self.get(kind, element_id)
86	        return Path(project_root) / element.fork_target
87	
88	    def fork(self, kind: str, element_id: str, *, project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT, overwrite: bool = False) -> Path:
89	        element = self.get(kind, element_id)
90	        target = self.fork_target(kind, element_id, project_root=project_root)
91	        if target.exists() and not overwrite:
92	            raise ElementRegistryError(f"element override already exists: {target}")
93	        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
94	        if target.exists():
95	            shutil.rmtree(target)
96	        shutil.copytree(element.root, target)
97	        return target
98	
99	
100	def load_default_registry(
101	    *,
102	    active_theme: str | Path | None = None,
103	    project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT,
104	    include_missing_roots: bool = False,
105	) -> ElementRegistry:
106	    registry = ElementRegistry()
107	    for element in load_pack_elements():
108	        registry.register(element)
109	    for source in default_sources(active_theme=active_theme, project_root=project_root):
110	        if not source.root.exists():
111	            if include_missing_roots:
112	                source.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
113	            else:
114	                continue
115	        for element in load_source_elements(source):
116	            registry.register(element)
117	    return registry
118	
119	
120	def default_sources(*, active_theme: str | Path | None = None, project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT) -> tuple[ElementSource, ...]:
121	    root = Path(project_root)
122	    theme_dir = _resolve_theme_dir(active_theme)
123	    sources: list[ElementSource] = []
124	    if theme_dir is not None:
125	        sources.extend(
126	            [
127	                ElementSource("active_theme", theme_dir / "elements", 0, True),
128	                ElementSource("active_theme", theme_dir, 0, True),
129	            ]
130	        )
131	    sources.extend(
132	        [
133	            ElementSource("overrides", root / ".artagents" / "elements" / "overrides", 10, True),
134	            ElementSource("managed", root / ".artagents" / "elements" / "managed", 20, False),
135	            ElementSource("bundled", _bundled_root(), 30, False),
136	        ]
137	    )
138	    return tuple(sources)
139	
140	
141	def load_pack_elements() -> tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]:
142	    elements: list[ElementDefinition] = []
143	    for pack in discover_packs():
144	        for kind, root in iter_element_roots(pack):
145	            element = load_element_definition(
146	                root,
147	                kind=kind,
148	                source=f"pack:{pack.id}",
149	                editable=pack.id == "local",
150	                priority=30,
151	            )
152	            validate_element_pack_id(element.metadata.get("pack_id"), pack, element_root=root)
153	            elements.append(element)
154	    return tuple(elements)
155	
156	
157	def load_source_elements(source: ElementSource) -> tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]:
158	    elements: list[ElementDefinition] = []
159	    for kind in ELEMENT_KINDS:
160	        kind_root = source.root / kind
161	        if not kind_root.is_dir():
162	            continue
163	        for child in sorted(kind_root.iterdir(), key=lambda path: path.name):
164	            if child.is_dir():
165	                try:
166	                    elements.append(
167	                        load_element_definition(
168	                            child,
169	                            kind=kind,
170	                            source=source.name,
171	                            editable=source.editable,
172	                            priority=source.priority,
173	                        )
174	                    )
175	                except ElementValidationError as exc:
176	                    print(f"WARN skipping {child}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
177	    return tuple(elements)
178	
179	
180	def _resolve_theme_dir(theme: str | Path | None) -> Path | None:
181	    raw = os.environ.get("HYPE_ACTIVE_THEME") if theme is None else theme
182	    if not raw:
183	        return None
184	    candidate = Path(raw).expanduser()
185	    if candidate.name == "theme.json":
186	        return candidate.parent.resolve()
187	    if candidate.exists():
188	        return (candidate if candidate.is_dir() else candidate.parent).resolve()
189	    return (REPO_ROOT.parent / "themes" / str(raw)).resolve()
190	
191	
192	def _bundled_root() -> Path:
193	    try:
194	        return Path(str(resources.files("artagents.elements.bundled")))
195	    except (ModuleNotFoundError, TypeError):
196	        return Path(__file__).with_name("bundled")

1	"""Schema dataclasses for render/custom elements."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	import re
7	from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
8	from pathlib import Path
9	from typing import Any, Literal
10	
11	ELEMENT_KINDS = ("effects", "animations", "transitions")
12	ElementKind = Literal["effects", "animations", "transitions"]
13	REQUIRED_ELEMENT_FILES = ("component.tsx", "schema.json", "defaults.json", "meta.json")
14	_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$")
15	
16	
17	class ElementValidationError(ValueError):
18	    """Raised when an element definition is invalid."""
19	
20	
21	@dataclass(frozen=True)
22	class ElementDependencies:
23	    js_packages: tuple[str, ...] = ()
24	    python_requirements: tuple[str, ...] = ()
25	
26	
27	@dataclass(frozen=True)
28	class ElementDefinition:
29	    id: str
30	    kind: ElementKind
31	    root: Path
32	    source: str
33	    editable: bool
34	    priority: int
35	    component: Path
36	    schema: dict[str, Any]
37	    defaults: dict[str, Any]
38	    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
39	    dependencies: ElementDependencies = field(default_factory=ElementDependencies)
40	
41	    @property
42	    def fork_target(self) -> Path:
43	        return Path(".artagents") / "elements" / "overrides" / self.kind / self.id
44	
45	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
46	        data = asdict(self)
47	        data["root"] = str(self.root)
48	        data["component"] = str(self.component)
49	        data["fork_target"] = str(self.fork_target)
50	        return data
51	
52	    def to_json(self, *, indent: int | None = 2) -> str:
53	        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent, sort_keys=True)
54	
55	
56	def load_element_definition(
57	    root: str | Path,
58	    *,
59	    kind: str,
60	    source: str,
61	    editable: bool,
62	    priority: int,
63	) -> ElementDefinition:
64	    element_root = Path(root)
65	    element_id = element_root.name
66	    try:
67	        schema = _read_object(element_root / "schema.json")
68	        defaults = _read_object(element_root / "defaults.json")
69	        metadata = _read_object(element_root / "meta.json")
70	    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
71	        raise ElementValidationError(f"missing required element file: {exc.filename}") from exc
72	    dependencies = _parse_dependencies(metadata.get("dependencies", {}), path=f"{element_root}/meta.json.dependencies")
73	    definition = ElementDefinition(
74	        id=str(metadata.get("id") or element_id),
75	        kind=_validate_kind(kind),
76	        root=element_root.resolve(),
77	        source=source,
78	        editable=editable,
79	        priority=priority,
80	        component=(element_root / "component.tsx").resolve(),
81	        schema=schema,
82	        defaults=defaults,
83	        metadata=dict(metadata),
84	        dependencies=dependencies,
85	    )
86	    return validate_element_definition(definition)
87	
88	
89	def validate_element_definition(raw: ElementDefinition | dict[str, Any]) -> ElementDefinition:
90	    if isinstance(raw, ElementDefinition):
91	        definition = raw
92	    else:
93	        definition = _parse_definition(raw)
94	    _validate_id(definition.id, "element.id")
95	    _validate_kind(definition.kind)
96	    if not definition.root.is_dir():
97	        raise ElementValidationError(f"element root is not a directory: {definition.root}")
98	    for filename in REQUIRED_ELEMENT_FILES:
99	        if not (definition.root / filename).is_file():
100	            raise ElementValidationError(f"element {definition.id!r} missing {filename}")
101	    if definition.metadata.get("id") not in (None, definition.id):
102	        raise ElementValidationError(f"element {definition.id!r} meta.json id does not match")
103	    if not isinstance(definition.schema, dict):
104	        raise ElementValidationError("element.schema must be an object")
105	    if not isinstance(definition.defaults, dict):
106	        raise ElementValidationError("element.defaults must be an object")
107	    if not isinstance(definition.metadata, dict):
108	        raise ElementValidationError("element.metadata must be an object")
109	    return definition
110	
111	
112	def _parse_definition(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> ElementDefinition:
113	    return ElementDefinition(
114	        id=str(raw["id"]),
115	        kind=_validate_kind(str(raw["kind"])),
116	        root=Path(raw["root"]),
117	        source=str(raw["source"]),
118	        editable=bool(raw["editable"]),
119	        priority=int(raw["priority"]),
120	        component=Path(raw["component"]),
121	        schema=dict(raw.get("schema", {})),
122	        defaults=dict(raw.get("defaults", {})),
123	        metadata=dict(raw.get("metadata", {})),
124	        dependencies=_parse_dependencies(raw.get("dependencies", {}), path="element.dependencies"),
125	    )
126	
127	
128	def _read_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
129	    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
130	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
131	        raise ElementValidationError(f"{path} must contain a JSON object")
132	    return data
133	
134	
135	def _parse_dependencies(raw: Any, *, path: str) -> ElementDependencies:
136	    if raw is None:
137	        return ElementDependencies()
138	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
139	        raise ElementValidationError(f"{path} must be an object")
140	    return ElementDependencies(
141	        js_packages=tuple(_string_list(raw.get("js_packages", ()), path=f"{path}.js_packages")),
142	        python_requirements=tuple(_string_list(raw.get("python_requirements", ()), path=f"{path}.python_requirements")),
143	    )
144	
145	
146	def _string_list(raw: Any, *, path: str) -> list[str]:
147	    if raw in (None, ()):
148	        return []
149	    if not isinstance(raw, list) or not all(isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in raw):
150	        raise ElementValidationError(f"{path} must be a list of non-empty strings")
151	    return list(raw)
152	
153	
154	def _validate_kind(kind: str) -> ElementKind:
155	    if kind not in ELEMENT_KINDS:
156	        raise ElementValidationError(f"element.kind must be one of {list(ELEMENT_KINDS)}")
157	    return kind  # type: ignore[return-value]
158	
159	
160	def _validate_id(value: str, path: str) -> None:
161	    if not _ID_RE.match(value) or "/" in value or "\\" in value or value in {".", ".."}:
162	        raise ElementValidationError(f"{path} must be a safe non-empty identifier")
163

13	// tools/remotion install. Add the Remotion project's node_modules to
14	// resolve.modules so they can `import` npm packages like
15	// @remotion/layout-utils that ship with this project.
16	const REMOTION_NODE_MODULES = path.resolve(__dirname, 'node_modules');
17	
18	const primitiveAliases = {
19	  '@theme-elements-effects': path.resolve(ACTIVE_THEME_DIR, 'elements/effects'),
20	  '@theme-effects': path.resolve(ACTIVE_THEME_DIR, 'effects'),
21	  '@override-elements-effects': path.resolve(OVERRIDE_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'effects'),
22	  '@managed-elements-effects': path.resolve(MANAGED_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'effects'),
23	  '@bundled-elements-effects': path.resolve(BUNDLED_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'effects'),
24	  '@theme-elements-animations': path.resolve(ACTIVE_THEME_DIR, 'elements/animations'),
25	  '@theme-animations': path.resolve(ACTIVE_THEME_DIR, 'animations'),
26	  '@override-elements-animations': path.resolve(OVERRIDE_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'animations'),
27	  '@managed-elements-animations': path.resolve(MANAGED_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'animations'),
28	  '@bundled-elements-animations': path.resolve(BUNDLED_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'animations'),
29	  '@theme-elements-transitions': path.resolve(ACTIVE_THEME_DIR, 'elements/transitions'),
30	  '@theme-transitions': path.resolve(ACTIVE_THEME_DIR, 'transitions'),
31	  '@override-elements-transitions': path.resolve(OVERRIDE_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'transitions'),
32	  '@managed-elements-transitions': path.resolve(MANAGED_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'transitions'),
33	  '@bundled-elements-transitions': path.resolve(BUNDLED_ELEMENTS_DIR, 'transitions'),
34	};
35	
36	export const applyRemotionPrimitiveAliases = (currentConfiguration) => ({
37	  ...currentConfiguration,
38	  resolve: {
39	    ...currentConfiguration.resolve,
40	    alias: {
41	      ...currentConfiguration.resolve?.alias,
42	      ...primitiveAliases,
43	    },
44	    modules: [
45	      ...(currentConfiguration.resolve?.modules ?? ['node_modules']),
46	      REMOTION_NODE_MODULES,
47	    ],
48	  },
49	});
50	
51	export const applyWorkspaceEffectsAlias = applyRemotionPrimitiveAliases;
52

132	def _load_plugin(
133	    root: Path,
134	    plugin_id: str,
135	    *,
136	    kind: ElementKind,
137	    scope: str,
138	) -> PluginRecord | None:
139	    missing = _missing_required_files(root)
140	    if missing:
141	        missing_text = ", ".join(missing)
142	        print(f"WARN skipping {root}: missing {missing_text}", file=sys.stderr)
143	        return None
144	    meta_path = root / "meta.json"
145	    meta = _load_json(meta_path)
146	    if meta.get("id") not in (None, plugin_id):
147	        raise ValueError(f"{meta_path} must contain matching id {plugin_id!r}")
148	    return PluginRecord(plugin_id=plugin_id, kind=kind, scope=scope, root=root, meta=meta)

151	def _scan_plugins(root: Path, *, kind: ElementKind, scope: str) -> dict[str, PluginRecord]:
152	    if not root.is_dir():
153	        return {}
154	    plugins: dict[str, PluginRecord] = {}
155	    singular = _singular(kind)
156	    for child in sorted(root.iterdir(), key=lambda path: path.name):
157	        if not child.is_dir():
158	            continue
159	        if not ID_RE.fullmatch(child.name):
160	            print(f"WARN skipping {child}: invalid {singular} id", file=sys.stderr)
161	            continue
162	        plugin = _load_plugin(child, child.name, kind=kind, scope=scope)
163	        if plugin is not None:
164	            plugins[child.name] = plugin
165	    return plugins

168	def discover_plugins(kind: ElementKind, theme_dir: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, PluginRecord]:
169	    _validate_kind(kind)
170	    registry = _element_registry(theme_dir)
171	    plugins: dict[str, PluginRecord] = {}
172	    singular = _singular(kind)
173	    for conflict in registry.conflicts():
174	        if conflict.kind == kind and conflict.winner.source == "active_theme":
175	            print(
176	                f"WARN theme '{_theme_id(theme_dir) or _theme_id_from_element(conflict.winner) or 'unknown'}' overrides workspace {singular} '{conflict.id}'",
177	                file=sys.stderr,
178	            )
179	    for element in registry.list(kind=kind):
180	        plugins[element.id] = _plugin_from_element(element, theme_dir=theme_dir)
181	    return plugins

210	        root=element.root,
211	        meta=element.metadata,
212	        import_scope=_import_scope_for_element(element, theme_dir=theme_dir),
213	    )

216	def _import_scope_for_element(element: ElementDefinition, *, theme_dir: Path | None) -> str:
217	    if element.source == "active_theme":
218	        if theme_dir is not None:
219	            theme_elements = theme_dir / "elements" / element.kind / element.id
220	            if element.root == theme_elements.resolve():
221	                return "theme-elements"
222	        return "theme"
223	    if element.source == "overrides":
224	        return "override-elements"
225	    if element.source == "managed":
226	        return "managed-elements"
227	    if element.source == "bundled":
228	        return "bundled-elements"
229	    return "managed-elements"
230

232	def _theme_id_from_element(element: ElementDefinition) -> str | None:
233	    if element.source != "active_theme":
234	        return None
235	    if element.root.parent.parent.name == "elements":
236	        return element.root.parent.parent.parent.name
237	    return element.root.parent.parent.name
238	
239	
240	def _clip_type_aliases(effects: dict[str, EffectRecord]) -> dict[str, str]:
241	    aliases: dict[str, str] = {}
242	    if "text-card" in effects:
243	        aliases["text"] = "text-card"
244	    for effect_id, effect in effects.items():
245	        raw_aliases = effect.meta.get("clipTypeAliases")
246	        if isinstance(raw_aliases, list):
247	            for alias in raw_aliases:
248	                if isinstance(alias, str) and alias:
249	                    aliases[alias] = effect_id
250	    return dict(sorted(aliases.items()))

253	def _ts_string(value: str) -> str:
254	    return "'" + value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'") + "'"
255	
256	
257	def _ts_json(value: Any) -> str:
258	    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
259	
260	
261	def _ts_property_key(value: str) -> str:
262	    return value if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*", value) else _ts_string(value)
263	
264	
265	def _write_active_theme_pointer(theme_dir: Path | None) -> None:
266	    if theme_dir is None:
267	        if ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.is_symlink() or ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.is_file():
268	            ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.unlink()
269	        if ACTIVE_THEME_POINTER.exists():
270	            ACTIVE_THEME_POINTER.unlink()
271	        return
272	
273	    if os.name == "nt":
274	        ACTIVE_THEME_POINTER.write_text(str(theme_dir.resolve()) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
275	        return
276	
277	    if ACTIVE_THEME_POINTER.exists():
278	        ACTIVE_THEME_POINTER.unlink()
279	    if ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.is_symlink() or ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.is_file():
280	        ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.unlink()
281	    elif ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.exists():
282	        raise RuntimeError(f"{ACTIVE_THEME_LINK} exists and is not a symlink")
283	    ACTIVE_THEME_LINK.symlink_to(theme_dir.resolve(), target_is_directory=True)
284	
285	
286	def _shim_module_text(kind: ElementKind, *, extension: str) -> str:
287	    package_module = f"@banodoco/timeline-composition/typescript/src/{kind}.generated"
288	    if extension in {".ts", ".js"}:
289	        return (
290	            "// DO NOT EDIT - generated shim by tools/scripts/gen_effect_registry.py\n"
291	            "// Re-exports the package-owned registry.\n"
292	            f"export * from '{package_module}';\n"
293	        )
294	    if extension == ".d.ts":
295	        return (
296	            "// DO NOT EDIT - generated shim by tools/scripts/gen_effect_registry.py\n"
297	            f"export * from '{package_module}';\n"
298	            f"//# sourceMappingURL={kind}.generated.d.ts.map\n"
299	        )
300	    raise ValueError(f"unsupported shim extension: {extension}")
301	
302	
303	def _empty_source_map(path: Path) -> str:
304	    return json.dumps(
305	        {"version": 3, "file": path.name, "sources": [], "names": [], "mappings": ""},
306	        sort_keys=True,
307	    ) + "\n"
308	
309	
310	def _write_shim_family(kind: ElementKind, shim_ts: Path) -> None:
311	    shim_ts.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
312	    base = shim_ts.with_suffix("")
313	    for extension in SHIM_EXTENSIONS:
314	        path = Path(f"{base}{extension}")
315	        if extension.endswith(".map"):
316	            path.write_text(_empty_source_map(path), encoding="utf-8")
317	        else:
318	            path.write_text(_shim_module_text(kind, extension=extension), encoding="utf-8")
319	
320	
321	def _write_generated_registry(path: Path, content: str) -> bool:
322	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
323	    try:
324	        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
325	    except PermissionError:
326	        return False
327	    return True
328	
329	
330	def generate(*, theme_dir: Path | None = None) -> str:
331	    return generate_element_registry("effects", theme_dir=theme_dir)
332	
333	
334	def generate_element_registry(kind: ElementKind, *, theme_dir: Path | None = None) -> str:
335	    _validate_kind(kind)
336	    if kind == "effects":
337	        return _generate_effect_registry(theme_dir=theme_dir)
338	
339	    component_type = "AnimationComponent" if kind == "animations" else "TransitionComponent"
340	    meta_type = "AnimationMeta" if kind == "animations" else "Record<string, unknown>"
341	    plugins = discover_plugins(kind, theme_dir)
342	    plugin_ids = sorted(plugins)
343	    imports = [
344	        f"import {_component_name(plugin_id)} from '{_import_path(plugins[plugin_id])}';"
345	        for plugin_id in plugin_ids
346	    ]
347	    registry_entries = [
348	        f"  '{plugin_id}': {_component_name(plugin_id)},"
349	        for plugin_id in plugin_ids
350	    ]
351	    defaults_entries = [
352	        f"  '{plugin_id}': {_ts_json(_load_json(plugins[plugin_id].root / 'defaults.json'))},"
353	        for plugin_id in plugin_ids
354	    ]
355	    meta_entries = [
356	        f"  '{plugin_id}': {_ts_json(plugins[plugin_id].meta)},"
357	        for plugin_id in plugin_ids
358	    ]
359	    ids = ", ".join(_ts_string(plugin_id) for plugin_id in plugin_ids)
360	    active_theme = f"{json.dumps(_theme_id(theme_dir))} as const" if theme_dir is not None else "null"
361	    ids_name = _ids_name(kind)
362	    type_name = _type_name(kind)
363	    registry_name = _registry_name(kind)
364	    defaults_name = f"{_constant_prefix(kind)}_DEFAULTS"
365	    meta_name = f"{_constant_prefix(kind)}_META"
366	    blocks = [
367	        "// DO NOT EDIT - generated by tools/scripts/gen_effect_registry.py",
368	        f"import type {{{component_type}, {meta_type}}} from './effects-types';"
369	        if kind == "animations"
370	        else f"import type {{{component_type}}} from './effects-types';",
371	        *imports,
372	        "",
373	        f"export const ACTIVE_THEME_ID = {active_theme};",
374	        f"export const {ids_name} = [{ids}] as const;",
375	        f"export type {type_name} = typeof {ids_name}[number];",
376	        f"export const {registry_name}: Record<{type_name}, {component_type}> = {{",
377	        *registry_entries,
378	        "};",
379	        f"export const {defaults_name}: Record<{type_name}, Record<string, unknown>> = {{",
380	        *defaults_entries,
381	        "};",
382	        f"export const {meta_name}: Record<{type_name}, {meta_type}> = {{",
383	        *meta_entries,
384	        "};",
385	        "",
386	    ]
387	    return "\n".join(blocks)
388	
389	
390	def _generate_effect_registry(*, theme_dir: Path | None = None) -> str:
391	    effects = discover_effects(theme_dir)
392	    effect_ids = sorted(effects)
393	    imports = [
394	        f"import {_component_name(effect_id)} from '{_import_path(effects[effect_id])}';"
395	        for effect_id in effect_ids
396	    ]
397	    registry_entries = [
398	        f"  '{effect_id}': {_component_name(effect_id)},"
399	        for effect_id in effect_ids
400	    ]
401	    ids = ", ".join(_ts_string(effect_id) for effect_id in effect_ids)
402	    aliases = _clip_type_aliases(effects)
403	    alias_entries = [
404	        f"  {_ts_property_key(alias)}: {_ts_string(effect_id)},"
405	        for alias, effect_id in aliases.items()
406	    ]
407	    active_theme = f"{json.dumps(_theme_id(theme_dir))} as const" if theme_dir is not None else "null"
408	    blocks = [
409	        "// DO NOT EDIT - generated by tools/scripts/gen_effect_registry.py",
410	        "import type {EffectComponent} from './effects-types';",
411	        *imports,
412	        "",
413	        f"export const ACTIVE_THEME_ID = {active_theme};",
414	        f"export const EFFECT_IDS = [{ids}] as const;",
415	        "export type EffectId = typeof EFFECT_IDS[number];",
416	        "export const EFFECT_REGISTRY: Record<EffectId, EffectComponent> = {",
417	        *registry_entries,
418	        "};",
419	        "export const CLIP_TYPE_ALIASES: Record<string, EffectId> = {",
420	        *alias_entries,
421	        "};",
422	        "",
423	    ]
424	    return "\n".join(blocks)
425	
426	
427	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
428	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate Remotion effect registry.")
429	    parser.add_argument("--theme", help="Theme id, theme directory, or path to theme.json.")
430	    return parser
431	
432	
433	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
434	    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
435	    theme_dir = _resolve_theme_dir(args.theme)
436	    _write_active_theme_pointer(theme_dir)
437	    failed_outputs: list[Path] = []
438	    for kind, output in OUTPUTS.items():
439	        content = generate_element_registry(kind, theme_dir=theme_dir)
440	        if not _write_generated_registry(output, content):
441	            failed_outputs.append(output)
442	    for kind, shim in SHIM_OUTPUTS.items():
443	        _write_shim_family(kind, shim)
444	    if failed_outputs:
445	        formatted = "\n".join(f"  - {path}" for path in failed_outputs)
446	        print(
447	            "ERROR failed to write package-owned generated registries:\n"
448	            f"{formatted}\n"
449	            "Remotion shim files were refreshed, but package outputs must be writable.",
450	            file=sys.stderr,
451	        )
452	        return 1
453	    return 0
454	
455	
456	if __name__ == "__main__":
457	    raise SystemExit(main())
458

  "command": "cat > /tmp/convert_elements.py <<'EOF'\nimport json, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nKIND_SINGULAR = {\"effects\": \"effect\", \"animations\": \"animation\", \"transitions\": \"transition\"}\nPACK_ROOT = Path(\"artagents/packs/builtin/elements\")\n\nfor kind_plural, kind_singular in KIND_SINGULAR.items():\n    kind_root = PACK_ROOT / kind_plural\n    if not kind_root.is_dir():\n        continue\n    for element_dir in sorted(kind_root.iterdir()):\n        if not element_dir.is_dir():\n            continue\n        meta_path = element_dir / \"meta.json\"\n        schema_path = element_dir / \"schema.json\"\n        defaults_path = element_dir / \"defaults.json\"\n        meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) if meta_path.is_file() else {}\n        schema = json.loads(schema_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) if schema_path.is_file() else {}\n        defaults = json.loads(defaults_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) if defaults_path.is_file() else {}\n        meta_id = meta.pop(\"id\", None) or element_dir.name\n        deps = meta.pop(\"dependencies\", {\"js_packages\": [], \"python_requirements\": []})\n        manifest = {\n            \"id\": meta_id,\n            \"kind\": kind_singular,\n            \"pack_id\": \"builtin\",\n            \"metadata\": meta,\n            \"schema\": schema,\n            \"defaults\": defaults,\n            \"dependencies\": deps,\n        }\n        (element_dir / \"element.yaml\").write_text(\n            json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + \"\\n\",\n            encoding=\"utf-8\",\n        )\n        for legacy in (meta_path, schema_path, defaults_path):\n            if legacy.is_file():\n                legacy.unlink()\n        print(f\"converted {kind_singular}.{meta_id}\")\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/convert_elements.py",
  "description": "Convert element manifests"
}

130	def _cmd_install(args: argparse.Namespace, registry: Any) -> int:
131	    element = registry.get(args.kind, args.element_id)
132	    result = install_element(element, project_root=REPO_ROOT, dry_run=not bool(args.apply))
133	    plan = result.plan
134	    if plan.noop_reason:
135	        print(f"{element.kind}/{element.id}: no install needed: {plan.noop_reason}")
136	        return result.returncode
137	    print(f"root: {plan.root}")
138	    if plan.venv_path is not None:
139	        print(f"venv: {plan.venv_path}")
140	    if plan.node_prefix is not None:
141	        print(f"node: {plan.node_prefix}")
142	    for line in plan.command_lines():
143	        print(line)
144	    if not args.apply:
145	        print("dry-run: pass --apply to run these local install commands")
146	    return result.returncode

149	def _sync_managed_defaults(*, dry_run: bool, overwrite: bool, project_root: Path | None = None) -> list[str]:
150	    project_root = project_root or REPO_ROOT
151	    bundled_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "packs" / "builtin" / "elements"
152	    if not bundled_root.is_dir():
153	        return ["no managed sync source available"]
154	    managed_root = project_root / ".artagents" / "elements" / "managed"
155	    override_root = project_root / ".artagents" / "elements" / "overrides"
156	    actions: list[str] = []
157	    for kind in ELEMENT_KINDS:
158	        source_kind = bundled_root / kind
159	        if not source_kind.is_dir():
160	            continue
161	        for source_element in sorted(source_kind.iterdir(), key=lambda path: path.name):
162	            if not source_element.is_dir():
163	                continue
164	            target = managed_root / kind / source_element.name
165	            override = override_root / kind / source_element.name
166	            if override.exists():
167	                actions.append(f"skip override: {override}")
168	                continue
169	            if target.exists() and not overwrite:
170	                actions.append(f"exists: {target}")
171	                continue
172	            if dry_run:
173	                actions.append(("update: " if target.exists() else "sync: ") + str(target))
174	                continue
175	            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
176	            if target.exists():
177	                shutil.rmtree(target)
178	            shutil.copytree(source_element, target)
179	            actions.append(("updated: " if overwrite else "synced: ") + str(target))
180	    if not actions:
181	        actions.append("no managed defaults to sync")
182	    return actions
183	
184	
185	def _print_actions(actions: list[str]) -> None:
186	    for action in actions:
187	        print(action)

191	    raise SystemExit(main())

5	import argparse

17	@dataclass(frozen=True)
18	class SetupStep:
19	    name: str
20	    status: str
21	    detail: str
22	
23	
24	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
25	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python3 -m artagents setup", description="Plan or apply ArtAgents local setup.")
26	    parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="Apply local setup mutations. Default is dry-run.")
27	    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit machine-readable setup output.")
28	    return parser
29	
30	
31	def plan_setup(*, apply: bool = False, project_root: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[SetupStep, ...]:
32	    root = Path(project_root or REPO_ROOT)
33	    steps: list[SetupStep] = []
34	    steps.append(
35	        SetupStep(
36	            name="mode",
37	            status="apply" if apply else "dry-run",
38	            detail="local mutations enabled" if apply else "no files or dependencies will be changed",
39	        )
40	    )
41	    steps.append(_plan_projects_root(apply=apply))
42	    steps.append(_plan_agents_symlink(root, apply=apply))
43	    for action in _sync_managed_defaults(dry_run=not apply, overwrite=False, project_root=root):
44	        steps.append(SetupStep(name="elements sync", status="applied" if apply else "planned", detail=action))
45	
46	    registry = load_element_registry(project_root=root)
47	    for element in registry.list():
48	        result = install_element(element, project_root=root, dry_run=not apply)
49	        plan = result.plan
50	        if plan.noop_reason:
51	            steps.append(SetupStep(name="elements install", status="skipped", detail=f"{element.kind}/{element.id}: {plan.noop_reason}"))
52	            continue
53	        status = "applied" if apply else "planned"
54	        details = "; ".join(plan.command_lines())
55	        steps.append(SetupStep(name="elements install", status=status, detail=f"{element.kind}/{element.id}: {details}"))
56	    return tuple(steps)
57	
58	
59	def _plan_projects_root(*, apply: bool) -> SetupStep:
60	    projects_root = resolve_projects_root()
61	    detail = f"{projects_root} ({PROJECTS_ROOT_ENV} override supported)"
62	    if projects_root.is_dir():
63	        return SetupStep(name="projects root", status="ok", detail=detail)
64	    if apply:
65	        projects_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
66	        return SetupStep(name="projects root", status="applied", detail=f"created {detail}")
67	    return SetupStep(name="projects root", status="planned", detail=f"will create {detail}")
68	
69	
70	def _plan_agents_symlink(root: Path, *, apply: bool) -> SetupStep:
71	    """Ensure AGENTS.md is a symlink to SKILL.md so both loaders read the same source."""
72	    agents = root / "AGENTS.md"
73	    target = "SKILL.md"
74	    skill = root / target
75	    if not skill.is_file():
76	        return SetupStep(name="agents.md symlink", status="warn", detail=f"{skill} missing; cannot link AGENTS.md")
77	    if agents.is_symlink() and (root / agents.readlink()).resolve() == skill.resolve():
78	        return SetupStep(name="agents.md symlink", status="ok", detail=f"AGENTS.md → {target}")
79	    if not agents.exists() and not agents.is_symlink():
80	        if apply:
81	            agents.symlink_to(target)
82	            return SetupStep(name="agents.md symlink", status="applied", detail=f"created AGENTS.md → {target}")
83	        return SetupStep(name="agents.md symlink", status="planned", detail=f"will create AGENTS.md → {target}")
84	    kind = "wrong symlink" if agents.is_symlink() else "regular file"
85	    if apply:
86	        agents.unlink()
87	        agents.symlink_to(target)
88	        return SetupStep(name="agents.md symlink", status="applied", detail=f"replaced AGENTS.md ({kind}) with symlink → {target}")
89	    return SetupStep(name="agents.md symlink", status="planned", detail=f"will replace AGENTS.md ({kind}) with symlink → {target}")
90	
91	
92	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
93	    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
94	    steps = plan_setup(apply=bool(args.apply))
95	    if args.json:
96	        payload = {
97	            "applied": bool(args.apply),
98	            "steps": [asdict(step) for step in steps],
99	        }
100	        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
101	        return 0
102	
103	    print("ArtAgents setup")
104	    if not args.apply:
105	        print("dry-run: pass --apply to sync managed defaults and run local element install commands")
106	    for step in steps:
107	        print(f"[{step.status}] {step.name}: {step.detail}")
108	    return 0
109	
110	
111	if __name__ == "__main__":
112	    raise SystemExit(main())

1	"""Element registry and source precedence."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import os
6	import shutil
7	import sys
8	from dataclasses import dataclass
9	from pathlib import Path
10	from types import MappingProxyType
11	from typing import Iterable
12	
13	from artagents._paths import REPO_ROOT
14	from artagents.core.pack import discover_packs, iter_element_roots, validate_element_pack_id
15	
16	from .schema import ELEMENT_KINDS, ElementDefinition, ElementKind, ElementValidationError, load_element_definition
17	
18	
19	class ElementRegistryError(ElementValidationError):
20	    """Raised when element registry state is inconsistent."""
21	
22	
23	@dataclass(frozen=True)
24	class ElementSource:
25	    name: str
26	    root: Path
27	    priority: int
28	    editable: bool
29	
30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True)
32	class ElementConflict:
33	    kind: ElementKind
34	    id: str
35	    winner: ElementDefinition
36	    shadowed: tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]
37	
38	
39	class ElementRegistry:
40	    """Resolved element registry keyed by kind and element id."""
41	
42	    def __init__(self, elements: Iterable[ElementDefinition] = ()) -> None:
43	        self._all: dict[tuple[str, str], list[ElementDefinition]] = {}
44	        for element in elements:
45	            self.register(element)
46	
47	    def register(self, element: ElementDefinition) -> ElementDefinition:
48	        key = (element.kind, element.id)
49	        self._all.setdefault(key, []).append(element)
50	        self._all[key].sort(key=lambda item: (item.priority, item.source, str(item.root)))
51	        return element
52	
53	    def get(self, kind: str, element_id: str) -> ElementDefinition:
54	        key = (kind, element_id)
55	        try:
56	            return self._all[key][0]
57	        except KeyError as exc:
58	            raise KeyError(f"unknown {kind} element {element_id!r}") from exc
59	
60	    def list(self, kind: str | None = None) -> tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]:
61	        if kind is not None and kind not in ELEMENT_KINDS:
62	            raise ElementRegistryError(f"kind must be one of {list(ELEMENT_KINDS)}")
63	        winners = [definitions[0] for (item_kind, _), definitions in self._all.items() if kind is None or item_kind == kind]
64	        return tuple(sorted(winners, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.id)))
65	
66	    def conflicts(self) -> tuple[ElementConflict, ...]:
67	        conflicts: list[ElementConflict] = []
68	        for (kind, element_id), definitions in self._all.items():
69	            if len(definitions) > 1:
70	                conflicts.append(
71	                    ElementConflict(
72	                        kind=kind,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
73	                        id=element_id,
74	                        winner=definitions[0],
75	                        shadowed=tuple(definitions[1:]),
76	                    )
77	                )
78	        return tuple(sorted(conflicts, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.id)))
79	
80	    def as_mapping(self) -> MappingProxyType[tuple[str, str], ElementDefinition]:
81	        return MappingProxyType({key: definitions[0] for key, definitions in self._all.items()})
82	
83	    def fork_target(self, kind: str, element_id: str, *, project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT) -> Path:
84	        element = self.get(kind, element_id)
85	        return Path(project_root) / element.fork_target
86	
87	    def fork(self, kind: str, element_id: str, *, project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT, overwrite: bool = False) -> Path:
88	        element = self.get(kind, element_id)
89	        target = self.fork_target(kind, element_id, project_root=project_root)
90	        if target.exists() and not overwrite:
91	            raise ElementRegistryError(f"element override already exists: {target}")
92	        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
93	        if target.exists():
94	            shutil.rmtree(target)
95	        shutil.copytree(element.root, target)
96	        return target
97	
98	
99	def load_default_registry(
100	    *,
101	    active_theme: str | Path | None = None,
102	    project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT,
103	    include_missing_roots: bool = False,
104	) -> ElementRegistry:
105	    registry = ElementRegistry()
106	    for element in load_pack_elements():
107	        registry.register(element)
108	    for source in default_sources(active_theme=active_theme, project_root=project_root):
109	        if not source.root.exists():
110	            if include_missing_roots:
111	                source.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
112	            else:
113	                continue
114	        for element in load_source_elements(source):
115	            registry.register(element)
116	    return registry
117	
118	
119	def default_sources(*, active_theme: str | Path | None = None, project_root: str | Path = REPO_ROOT) -> tuple[ElementSource, ...]:
120	    root = Path(project_root)
121	    theme_dir = _resolve_theme_dir(active_theme)
122	    sources: list[ElementSource] = []
123	    if theme_dir is not None:
124	        sources.extend(
125	            [
126	                ElementSource("active_theme", theme_dir / "elements", 0, True),
127	                ElementSource("active_theme", theme_dir, 0, True),
128	            ]
129	        )
130	    sources.extend(
131	        [
132	            ElementSource("overrides", root / ".artagents" / "elements" / "overrides", 10, True),
133	            ElementSource("managed", root / ".artagents" / "elements" / "managed", 20, False),
134	        ]
135	    )
136	    return tuple(sources)
137	
138	
139	def load_pack_elements() -> tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]:
140	    elements: list[ElementDefinition] = []
141	    for pack in discover_packs():
142	        for kind, root in iter_element_roots(pack):
143	            element = load_element_definition(
144	                root,
145	                kind=kind,
146	                source=f"pack:{pack.id}",
147	                editable=pack.id == "local",
148	                priority=30,
149	            )
150	            validate_element_pack_id(element.metadata.get("pack_id"), pack, element_root=root)
151	            elements.append(element)
152	    return tuple(elements)
153	
154	
155	def load_source_elements(source: ElementSource) -> tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]:
156	    from .schema import ELEMENT_MANIFEST_NAMES
157	
158	    elements: list[ElementDefinition] = []
159	    for kind in ELEMENT_KINDS:
160	        kind_root = source.root / kind
161	        if not kind_root.is_dir():
162	            continue
163	        for child in sorted(kind_root.iterdir(), key=lambda path: path.name):
164	            if not child.is_dir():
165	                continue
166	            if not any((child / name).is_file() for name in ELEMENT_MANIFEST_NAMES):
167	                continue
168	            try:
169	                elements.append(
170	                    load_element_definition(
171	                        child,
172	                        kind=kind,
173	                        source=source.name,
174	                        editable=source.editable,
175	                        priority=source.priority,
176	                    )
177	                )
178	            except ElementValidationError as exc:
179	                print(f"WARN skipping {child}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
180	    return tuple(elements)
181	
182	
183	def _resolve_theme_dir(theme: str | Path | None) -> Path | None:
184	    raw = os.environ.get("HYPE_ACTIVE_THEME") if theme is None else theme
185	    if not raw:
186	        return None
187	    candidate = Path(raw).expanduser()
188	    if candidate.name == "theme.json":
189	        return candidate.parent.resolve()
190	    if candidate.exists():
191	        return (candidate if candidate.is_dir() else candidate.parent).resolve()
192	    return (REPO_ROOT.parent / "themes" / str(raw)).resolve()
193

  sources: list[ElementSource] = []\n    if theme_dir is not None:\n        sources.extend(\n            [\n                ElementSource(\"active_theme\", theme_dir / \"elements\", 0, True),\n                ElementSource(\"active_theme\", theme_dir, 0, True),\n            ]\n        )\n    return tuple(sources)\n\n\ndef load_pack_elements() -> tuple[ElementDefinition, ...]:\n    elements: list[ElementDefinition] = []\n    for pack in discover_packs():\n        priority = 10 if pack.id == \"local\" else 30\n        for kind, root in iter_element_roots(pack):\n            element = priority=priority,\n            )\n            validate_element_pack_id(element.metadata.get(\"pack_id\"), pack, element_root=root)\n            elements.append(element)\n    return pack_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    manifest = pack_root / \"pack.yaml\"\n    if not manifest.exists():\n        manifest.write_text(\"id: local\\nname: Local Scratch Pack\\nversion: 0.1.0\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    return pack_root\n\n\ndef _rewrite_pack_id(element_root: Path, new_pack_id: str) -> None:\n    from .schema import ELEMENT_MANIFEST_NAMES\n\n    for name in ELEMENT_MANIFEST_NAMES:\n        manifest = element_root / name\n        if not manifest.is_file():\n            continue\n        data = json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        data[\"pack_id\"] = new_pack_id\n        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        return"
